mechanism: Sulfamethoxazole may inhibit monoamine oxidase metabolism and sulfamethoxazole metabolites can accumulate serotonergic activity when combined with phenelzine, a non-selective MAOI, increasing serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Avoid this combination if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia, tremor), and consider alternative antibiotics.
